title: Puttering Pufferfish
statement: Hovering like a wide-eyed dirigible among mossy slate arches and sun-dappled sea fans, this meticulous little swimmer spends its days puffing gentle currents to arrange iridescent pebbles into tidy, swirling mandalas. Whenever it finishes a pattern, it pauses beside the glass to bob proudly with a flutter of its translucent fins.
